blocks.text: Pode mukhtalif qism ki jagahon (habitats) mein milte hain: pani wali (aquatic), mo'tadil (moderate), bohat khushk (dry) zameen aur namkeen (saline). Isi liye unhen tarteeb se hydrophytes, mesophytes, xerophytes aur halophytes kehte hain.

Hydrophytes pani wale mahol, samundari (marine) aur meethe pani (freshwater) dono, mein rehne ke liye khaas osmotic tareeqon se dhal gaye hain. Samundari hydrophytes namkeen (hypertonic) pani mein achhi tarah ugte hain, jahan pani un ke cells se bahar nikalne ki koshish karta hai. Yeh zaid namak khaas salt glands se bahar nikalte hain aur proline, glycine betaine aur sugars jaise organic solutes banate hain. In solutes se cells ka osmotic potential kam (zyada negative) ho jata hai aur pani cells mein ruka rehta hai. In ki cuticles (patte par mom jaisi teh) moti hoti hain jo pani ka ziyan aur kam karti hain, aur yeh zyada namak bardasht karne wali halophytic khasoosiyat rakhte hain. Meethe pani ke hydrophytes hypotonic mahol mein ugte hain, jahan pani lagataar un ke cells mein aata rehta hai. Yeh pode zaid pani hydathodes (patton ke kinaron par pani nikalne wale surakh) ya vacuoles jaisi banawaton se bahar nikalte hain taake cells mein pani hadd se zyada na ho. Yeh potassium aur calcium jaise zaroori ions active transport se jazb karte hain taake patle (dilute) pani mein bhi osmotic tawazun qaim rahe. In ki cuticles patli hoti hain ya hoti hi nahin, is liye pani ka len den asaan rehta hai. In ki jarein aksar chhoti hoti hain, kyun ke yeh nutrients aur pani seedha apne gird ke pani se jazb kar lete hain. Hydrophytes ki misalein: water lily, kanwal (lotus), seaweeds aur tape grass.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke samundari hydrophytes solutes bana kar apna “osmotic potential barhate” hain. Sahi yeh hai ke solutes barhne se osmotic (solute) potential kam, yani zyada negative, hota hai (topic 8.4), aur cells ka water potential gir jata hai; jo cheez barhti hai woh osmotic pressure hai. Isi liye pani cells mein ruka rehta hai.

Mesophytes mo'tadil mahol mein rehte hain jo na zyada khushk ho na zyada geela. Yeh aisi mitti pasand karte hain jis mein pani khara na ho (not waterlogged) aur namak aur nami (humidity) darmiyani ho. Mesophytes ki jarein aur shoots achhi tarah bani hoti hain aur in ka vascular system mukammal hota hai. Inhen zinda rehne ke liye kisi khaas tabdeeli (adaptation) ki zaroorat nahin hoti. In ke patte chapte, chaure aur hare hote hain aur satah par stomata hote hain. Mesophytes ki misalein: gulab (rose), tamatar aur daisy.

Xerophytes woh pode hain jo khushk halaat mein zinda rehne ke liye dhal gaye hain. In mein pani ka ziyan kam karne aur pani zakheera karne ki khaas tabdeeliyan hoti hain. Pani zakheera karne wale podon ko succulents kehte hain. In ke gudedar (fleshy) tane pani jama rakhte hain jo zaroorat par istemal hota hai. Xerophytes ki doosri tabdeeliyan: patton par mom ki teh (waxy coating) taake pani kam ure, khushk mausam mein patte gira dena, aur dhoop ko behtar tareeqe se lene ke liye patton ko mor lena ya un ka rukh badalna. Xerophytes ki misalein: kantedar darakht (thorn trees), desert marigold aur blue agave.

Halophytes namkeen mitti mein rehte hain jis mein NaCl, MgCl₂, MgSO₄ jaise namak zyada hon, ya namkeen pani mein. Aisi zameen par sirf wohi pode ug sakte hain jo in namkon ki kafi zyada concentration bardasht kar saken. In podon ke patte gudedar (succulent) hote hain aur kabhi kabhi tana bhi gudedar hota hai. Kuch podon mein patte kanton (spines) mein badal jate hain. Halophytes ki misalein: sea arrowgrass aur sea lavender.
Samundar ke kinare daldali (marshy) jagahon par ugne wale halophytes ek khaas qism ka jungle banate hain jise mangrove ya tidal woodland kehte hain. Inhen helophilous halophytes bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Meethe pani ka ek poda aur ek samundari seaweed, dono ko osmosis ka ek masla rehta hai. Har ek ka masla aur us ka ek hal (adaptation) batayein.
blocks.explanation: Meethe pani ka poda hypotonic pani mein hai, is liye pani us ke cells mein aata rehta hai; woh zaid pani hydathodes ya vacuoles se nikalta hai aur potassium aur calcium jaise ions jazb karta hai. Seaweed hypertonic samundari pani mein hai, is liye pani us ke cells se nikalna chahta hai; woh zaid namak salt glands se nikalta hai aur proline jaise organic solutes bana kar pani rokta hai.

items: Osmoregulation andar ke pani aur solutes ka tawazun rakhti hai. Hypotonic mahlool mein cell phoolta hai, hypertonic mein sukarta hai (plasmolysis), isotonic mein koi net harkat nahin.

Hydrophytes: samundari namak nikalte, organic solutes banate aur moti cuticle rakhte hain; meethe pani wale zaid pani nikalte, ions lete, patli cuticle aur chhoti jarein rakhte hain. Mesophytes ko khaas tabdeeli nahin chahiye. Xerophytes pani jama karte (succulents) aur mom, patte girane aur morne se pani bachate hain. Halophytes namkeen zameen mein gudedar patton aur tanon ke saath ugte hain; mangroves kinare ke halophytes hain.
